positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Work as a full-stack engineer developing backend services and user-facing tools that support scientific and operational workflows.

Lead development and operation of Enko’s internal cloud platform, managing infrastructure, automation, and multi-environment deployments.

Build and maintain Python-based data pipelines that sync, transform, and integrate data across external vendors and internal systems.

Implement MLOps practices enabling scalable model development, experiment tracking, and deployment.
positions.insights: Skills: Troubleshooting · Version Control · Test Automation Frameworks · API Development · Bioinformatics · Software Projects · Visualization · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Amazon S3 · Software Infrastructure

positions.title: Senior Healthcare Economist
positions.description:
·	Develop interactive dashboards for senior executive leadership to display KPIs
·	Work with business stakeholders to make strategies to grow our business
·	Automate, stream line, and implement processes with python and SQL

positions.title: Associate Data Engineer
positions.description:
·	Automate recurring jobs to reduce overall ticket volume
·	Write ETL scripts to automate loading external data to internal production tables
·	Create SSIS packages in conjunction with SQL procedures
·	Write DML/DDL scripts for both biweekly and code monthly deployments

positions.title: Senior Analyst
positions.description:
·	Wrote complex SQL queries to quantify and track company-wide issues
       o	       Use Excel to provide concise summaries and updates for senior leadership
·	Wrote SQL and Python scripts to automate reoccurring jobs
       o	       Turned a manual 2 hour data reconciliation task to 3 minutes
       o	       Automated weekly reports for internal and external members
·	Developed Front-end/Back-end GUI Application 
       o	       Used by 15+ coworkers to track their issues
       o	       Automatically generates standardized reports for senior leadership

positions.title: Analyst
positions.description:
Promoted to Senior Analyst
·	Managed sensitive healthcare provider accounts, advising on claims issues
·	Conducted ADHOC reporting and data analysis requests

positions.title: Volunteer Income Tax Assistant
positions.description:
•	Volunteered for the 2013 and 2014 tax seasons
•	Volunteer Income Tax Assistance and Tax Counseling for the Elderly (VITA/TCE) certified
•	Organized and obtained information from clients to prepare returns using Taxwise software

positions.title: Prevention Assistant
positions.description:
•	Conducted research to collect data on demographics, education, and crime in the City of Newburgh

•	Compared demographics and the lifestyle of Newburgh city to neighboring cities, Orange County and New York

•	Created a 40 page archive report that contains research data to assist the coalition TEAM Newburgh in improving the city
